newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Mobutu envoy briefs Nigerian ruler, off to Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu envoy briefs Nigerian ruler, off to Egypt.

text.p: An envoy of ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko of Zaire left Abuja on Thursday for Cairo after briefing Nigeria's military ruler General Sani Abacha on fighting in eastern Zaire, officials said.

They said Nzambo-Ko Atumba, Mobutu's special adviser on security affairs, gave a detailed account of the situation in eastern Zaire where rebel forces are in control but did not ask for Nigerian troops to be involved.
"The head of state responded that Nigeria is willing to render any assistance that could amicably resolve the current situation in Zaire," one official at the briefing said.
The envoy was on an African tour that had already taken him to Ivory Coast and Cameroon. He was on his way to Egypt and would visit several other African capitals after that.
More than a million war refugees are in danger of starving to death in eastern Zaire.
